question: How many days does a refund take to reflect in my bank account?
answer: Refunds are processed within 24 hours of pickup and take 3 to 5 business days to reflect in your bank account.

question: What is the return window for electronics and mobile phones?
answer: Electronics and mobile phones have a 7-day replacement-only window for manufacturing defects or damaged deliveries.

question: What is the return policy for clothing and footwear?
answer: Clothing and footwear can be returned or exchanged within 14 days of delivery as long as tags are intact and items are unwashed.

question: How much do I need to spend to get free shipping?
answer: Orders worth ₹499 or more qualify for free standard delivery; orders below ₹499 incur a ₹40 shipping fee.

question: Can I cancel my order after it has been shipped?
answer: Once an order is shipped, it cannot be cancelled in the app, but you can refuse delivery at your doorstep for a full refund.

question: Is Cash on Delivery available for all pin codes?
answer: Cash on Delivery (COD) is available on orders up to ₹10,000 across serviceable pin codes, subject to a ₹15 handling fee.

question: How do I download my GST invoice?
answer: Go to My Orders, select your delivered item, and tap 'Download Invoice' to get your GST-compliant PDF.

question: What should I do if I received a damaged or wrong product?
answer: Raise a return request within 48 hours of delivery with clear photos of the packaging and product for an instant replacement.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: You can update your delivery address in Order Details only before the package is packed and dispatched.

question: How long does standard delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 2 to 4 business days in metro cities and 4 to 7 business days in non-metro locations.

question: How can I track my live order status?
answer: Open My Orders in the app and tap 'Track Package' to see real-time courier updates and estimated delivery time.

question: Do you offer no-cost EMI on credit cards?
answer: Yes, 3-month and 6-month No-Cost EMI is available on orders above ₹3,000 for HDFC, ICICI, SBI, and Axis credit cards.

question: Can I pay using UPI at the time of Cash on Delivery?
answer: Yes, you can scan the courier partner's dynamic QR code at your doorstep and pay via any UPI app instead of cash.

question: What items are non-returnable on your platform?
answer: Innerwear, personal care items, perishables, and opened software or gift cards are non-returnable for hygiene and security reasons.

question: How do I redeem a gift card or promo voucher?
answer: Enter your 16-digit gift card code under Account > Gift Cards to add it to your wallet balance before checkout.

question: What is the validity period of a gift card?
answer: All digital and physical gift cards are valid for 12 months from the date of issue and cannot be reloaded.

question: How do I claim manufacturer warranty on an appliance?
answer: Use your downloaded GST invoice at any authorized brand service center to claim the standard 1-year manufacturer warranty.

question: Is open-box delivery available for high-value electronics?
answer: Yes, open-box delivery is mandatory for smartphones, laptops, and smartwatches so you can verify the device before sharing the OTP.

question: Why did my UPI payment fail even though money was debited?
answer: If money was debited during a failed UPI transaction, your bank automatically reverses the amount within 48 hours.

question: Can I schedule a specific delivery time slot?
answer: Same-day and next-day orders in select metro cities allow you to pick a 2-hour delivery slot during checkout.

question: How do I contact customer care on phone or chat?
answer: Go to Help Center > Contact Us in the app for 24/7 live chat or request an instant callback between 8 AM and 10 PM.

question: What happens if I miss my delivery attempt?
answer: Our courier partner makes up to 3 delivery attempts over consecutive days before returning the package to our warehouse.

question: Can I exchange a clothing item for a different size?
answer: Yes, free size exchanges are supported within 14 days of delivery subject to stock availability of the requested size.

question: Are there extra charges for express one-day delivery?
answer: One-day express delivery costs ₹79 per order for standard users and is completely free for Plus members.

question: How do I delete or deactivate my shopping account?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Privacy > Delete Account; permanent deletion completes after a 7-day cooling period if no orders are active.

question: Can I place a bulk order for corporate gifting?
answer: Yes, orders of 10 or more units qualify for bulk pricing and GST input tax credit via our Business Store portal.

question: Where will my refund go if I paid via Cash on Delivery?
answer: For Cash on Delivery orders, refunds are credited either to your linked UPI ID/bank account or instantly to your app wallet.

question: How do I apply a bank discount offer at checkout?
answer: Select an eligible bank card on the payment page and the instant discount will automatically deduct before you enter your OTP.

question: Can I add more items to an order that is already placed?
answer: You cannot edit items in a confirmed order; please place a separate order or cancel and reorder before dispatch.

question: Do you deliver outside India or internationally?
answer: Currently we only deliver within India across 19,000+ pin codes and do not support international shipping.
